items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: You could tell Jimmy Newt and Dodd and those people. Yeah. There was a difference between Jimmy Newt and Dodd and Bichet. All three of them fellas played different. They all were good.

ctx.x: Certain ones you could always tell. You could tell bass his piano playing, you could tell Benny Goodman. You could tell Jimmy Newt and Dodd and those people. Yeah. There was a difference between Jimmy Newt and Dodd and Bichet. All three of them fellas played different. They all were good.
